title: Agentic Presentation Builder
description: An LLM-friendly, JSON-based presentation engine that renders structured deck definitions into interactive Reveal.js presentations with Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, syntax-highlighted code, and animated progressive reveals. Ships an apb command-line interface for validating, serving, and exporting decks.
